import os,json,stat,subprocess,tempfile,time,http.client
from pathlib import Path
UNIT=Path('/etc/systemd/system/fadego-staging.service')
ROOT=Path('/srv/projects/fadego')
PRIVATE=ROOT/'private/systemd-env'
BACKUP=PRIVATE/'.fadego-staging-service-before-private-env-20261104'
PAIRS=[('/etc/fadego-staging/app.env',PRIVATE/'app.env'),('/etc/fadego-staging/send-closed.env',PRIVATE/'send-closed.env')]
REPL=[('EnvironmentFile=/etc/fadego-staging/app.env','EnvironmentFile='+str(PRIVATE/'app.env')),('EnvironmentFile=/etc/fadego-staging/send-closed.env','EnvironmentFile='+str(PRIVATE/'send-closed.env'))]
SVC=('ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads')
result={'project':'fadego','operation':'switch_existing_systemd_env_paths','status':'PRECHECK','unit_modified':False,'rollback':False,'owner_vault_untouched':True}
old=None
def sys(args,timeout=20):
 a=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 return a.returncode
def active():return {s:sys(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet',s])==0 for s in SVC}
def http():
 try:
  c=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',3100,timeout=6);c.request('GET','/',headers={'Host':'127.0.0.1'});r=c.getresponse();n=r.status;c.close();return n
 except Exception:return 0
def atomic(data,meta):
 fd,path=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.fadego-service-stage-',dir=UNIT.parent)
 try:
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(data);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
  os.chmod(path,stat.S_IMODE(meta.st_mode));os.chown(path,meta.st_uid,meta.st_gid)
  os.replace(path,UNIT)
 finally:
  if os.path.exists(path):os.unlink(path)
try:
 assert os.geteuid()==0 and UNIT.is_file() and not UNIT.is_symlink() and PRIVATE.is_dir() and not PRIVATE.is_symlink()
 assert not BACKUP.exists() and not BACKUP.is_symlink(),'backup conflict'
 baseline=active()
 assert all(baseline.values()),'another essential service not active before change'
 ready=False
 for _ in range(6):
  if http()==200:ready=True;break
  time.sleep(2)
 assert ready,'FADEGO preflight HTTP not 200 after retries'
 for src,dest in PAIRS:
  a=Path(src)
  assert a.is_file() and not a.is_symlink() and dest.is_file() and not dest.is_symlink()
  assert a.read_bytes()==dest.read_bytes(),'staged config differs from active config'
 old=UNIT.read_bytes();meta=UNIT.stat()
 text=old.decode()
 for a,b in REPL:
  assert text.count(a)==1,'unexpected source unit'
  text=text.replace(a,b)
 assert 'EnvironmentFile=/etc/fadego-staging/' not in text
 assert text!=old.decode()
 fd=os.open(BACKUP,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as b:b.write(old);b.flush();os.fsync(b.fileno())
 atomic(text.encode(),meta);result['unit_modified']=True
 assert sys(['systemd-analyze','verify',str(UNIT)],30)==0,'systemd-analyze verify failed'
 assert sys(['systemctl','daemon-reload'],30)==0,'daemon reload failed'
 assert sys(['systemctl','restart','fadego-staging'],45)==0,'FADEGO restart failed'
 good=False
 for _ in range(15):
  if sys(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet','fadego-staging'])==0 and http()==200:
   good=True;break
  time.sleep(2)
 assert good,'FADEGO HTTP 200 not recovered'
 now=active()
 assert all(now.values()),'a service changed status after switching'
 assert UNIT.read_bytes()==text.encode()
 result.update({'status':'SWITCHED_AND_TESTED','service_active':True,'http_status':200,'nine_services_active':True,'root_unit_uses_private_paths':True})
except Exception as e:
 result.update({'status':'FAILED_ROLLBACK_REQUIRED','reason':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:175]})
 if result['unit_modified'] and old is not None:
  try:
   atomic(old,meta)
   sys(['systemctl','daemon-reload'],30)
   sys(['systemctl','restart','fadego-staging'],50)
   result['rollback']=True
   result['service_restored']=sys(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet','fadego-staging'])==0
  except Exception as b:result['rollback_issue']=type(b).__name__
print(json.dumps(result,separators=(',',':')))
